title: Retiree with other income, sent to a human
description: A retired applicant living on Social Security and a pension chooses employment status 'other' and uploads no income documents, which the form allows for 'other'. Applicants who are neither employed nor self-employed are out of scope for automatic processing, but under Regulation B a lender may not ignore income from pensions or public assistance, so the application must be sent to a human, never cancelled or rejected. The agent must not ask for a pay stub or W-2 (there is no employer) and sends no message to the customer; telling the customer about the handover is the system's job.
